reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows through replace() sanitization into filter string '(uid='+safe+')', which is passed to ctx.search() at line 25. The resolved sink value is '(uid=<user_input_escaped>)'. While some escaping occurs, the custom escape patterns (\\5c, \\2a, etc.) are not standard LDAP escapes—proper LDAP escaping prefixes chars with backslash (e.g., \*). Attacker input can still inject LDAP operators like *(objectClass=*), +(uid=+admin), |(&(uid=admin)(|(cn=test)))|, etc., since the escaping doesn't neutralize LDAP metacharacters effectively.
